title: Tell us where to start
intro: Three short questions. Skipping this leaves the default 'start at Module 0' emphasis in place. Your answers are private and never gate paid content or skip safety foundations.

questions.prompt: Have you ever managed a Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, or Sponsored Display campaign?

options.label: I have watched someone else run one
Yes, I have run a small campaign myself

questions.prompt: How comfortable are you reading ACoS, CPC, CTR, and conversion-rate reports?

options.label: I do not know those terms yet
I know the terms but have not used them on the job
I read those reports to make decisions
I train others to read those reports

questions.prompt: If a campaign's ACoS jumps from 25% to 40%, what is the first thing you would check before changing a bid?

options.label: Stop the campaign and ask the client
Read the search-term report, the listing, and the time window first, then decide
Compare to last quarter and the category benchmark before deciding

outcomes.label: New to Amazon PPC
outcomes.summary: You are starting fresh. Spend the first 20 minutes on Module 0 to learn the daily work loop and finish one guided practice decision before moving on.
outcomes.startingEmphasis: Begin with Module 0, then complete the guided first decision in the Bid Elevator tool.

outcomes.label: Familiar with PPC
outcomes.summary: You know the terms. Module 0 will set the safety boundaries and the client-brief intake you need before touching a live account, then Module 1 will sharpen the math behind every decision.
outcomes.startingEmphasis: Skim Module 0 for the safety checklist, then focus on Module 1 metrics and Module 2 keyword research.

outcomes.label: Experienced operator
outcomes.summary: You have run campaigns. Module 0 will reset you to the course's safety and reporting standards, and Module 5 onward will sharpen the client-facing portfolio, budget, and seasonal decisions.
outcomes.startingEmphasis: Skim Module 0, then move to Module 5 portfolio strategy and Module 10 reporting.
